statement: Is it true that, for all finite $k<\omega$,\[\omega_1^2\to (\omega_1\omega, 3,\ldots,3)_{k+1}^2?\]
remarks: Baumgartner \cite{Ba89b} proved that, assuming a form of Martin's axiom, that $\omega_1\omega\to (\omega_1\omega, 3)^2$.
references: [Ba89b] Baumgartner, James E., Remarks on partition ordinals. (1989), 5--17.
